root_cause: Kubernetes reported rollout completion immediately before the second terminating old Pod persisted its preStop drain event. The original time-window query therefore observed one of two exact Pod drain events even though the second event committed milliseconds later.
remediation: Bind expected drain evidence to the exact pre-rollout Pod UID set instead of an inferred timestamp window.
Require the rollout to have the exact new release replicas and zero terminating Pods before querying drain evidence.
Require the observed drain identity set to equal the exact expected Pod UID set.
claim_boundary: This failed local controlled attempt is retained as RCA evidence and provides no S6 acceptance credit.
